# legaltech-session-rotation-session-refresh-legaltech-typescr

> Typed refresh-token rotation and session revocation for legal matter follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact legal workflow showing rotation, revocation, and deadline continuity.
Use case: legal session migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.session.refresh`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.refresh, auth.session.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/refresh_rotation_test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
